releaseNotes.headline: Every tool’s ring breathes
releaseNotes.summary: Version 0.2.14 lights the rail for Claude Code, Cursor, and Grok Build sessions, signs its updates, and keeps Magnet on the right display.

highlights.title: Session lights for every tool
highlights.detail: Each ring breathes while that tool has an agent working, turns green when a session finishes, amber when it is waiting on you, and pink on an error. Paired iPhones and the Watch show the same status.

highlights.title: Signed updates
highlights.detail: Update manifests now carry a signature from the release key, so the app only installs builds that were published by usAIge.

highlights.title: Magnet remembers its display
highlights.detail: A docked rail comes back on the edge you chose, even beside a second display or after one is unplugged, and a cancelled drag no longer leaves a tool row dimmed.
